lines: +# Notes
+## Diagnosis
+Screening showed most base-model failures were near misses, not zero progress: on 28/38 tasks the base model
+regularly passed a subset of the checker tests, and almost every task's failures concentrated on 1–3 specific
+checks (often ones the instruction only implies). Binary rewards nonetheless give GRPO all-zero groups and no
+gradient. Two things can create signal from legal sources only: the fraction of tests passed (partial credit),
+and retries that see the checker's report (`rlsdk.feedback`: passed/failed test names and counts), which points
+at the missing requirement.
+## Algorithm (plugin v0–v2, one 80-step run `fcr1`)
+- Half of each task group (n=8) runs plain, exactly as at evaluation. The other half runs in a fresh container
+  with an extra instruction: fixed task-agnostic guidance text (re-read the task, infer what each failed check
+  verifies, verify before submitting, clean up test artifacts) plus the checker report of the best-scoring
+  previous attempt on that task (persisted across steps in the job's `algo_state`).
+- Reward = fraction of checker tests passed (+0.5 bonus for a full pass), group-normalized GRPO advantages, so
+  conditioned successes and partial progress produce a gradient where binary rewards do not.
+- Once a task passes unconditioned, conditioning stops for it, so later steps consolidate the plain behavior
+  (v1 fix: a conditioned pass alone does not count as solved).
+- From step 26 (v2), conditioned episodes also got a short failure analysis written by the policy itself
+  (`rlsdk.policy.chat` from instruction + checker report only) and a +0.1 temperature bump.
+- Selection: 35 tasks weighted by screening partial progress (the 3 long, zero-progress tasks excluded);
+  8 tasks × 8 episodes/step, lr 2e-6, T=1.0, max_seq_len 49152, rollout_tail_s 300, 80 steps (5120 episodes).
+## What moved
+- Conditioned retries produced the first-ever passes (by step ~9: 5 conditioned passes on 4 tasks vs 1 plain),
+  confirming feedback unlocks solves the base policy never finds.
+- Plain (eval-like) passes followed and concentrated: by the end, 291 plain passes in training. Last-24 plain
+- Many mostly-content-check tasks never moved: pass fraction stayed pinned (e.g. 0.50 on 2-test tasks) under
+  both plain and conditioned attempts — the failed test name alone does not tell the model what value is wrong.
+## Expectation
+Shipped checkpoint is iter 79 of `fcr1` (80 GRPO steps). I expect real pass@1 on the six claimed tasks
+(`zp_0ad7fa007a10` and `zp_b713519954ee` high, the others partial), possibly stray passes on
+`task_009871_79982d75`, `task_003903_64bfce86`, `task_008669_12703650` (each passed plainly in training at
+least once), and ~0 elsewhere. Overall pass@1 over 38 tasks likely in the low single digits (percent), up from 0.
